CRISPUS ATTUCKS SHALL ARRIVE WITH THE BOSTON COMMONS, TO TAKE ELISSI LANDI NORTH, CRISPUS ATTUCKS SHALL BE LAYING ON BOSTON COMMONS, ELISSI LANDI SHALL FEEL ALIVE AGAIN. I SHALL CALL HER NAME AS SHE STEPS ON TO THE BOSTON COMMONS, AND FLIES NORTH FOREVER, LINCOLN SHALL BE THERE, TO SEE THEM LEAVE THE SOUTH FOREVER, ELISSI LANDI, SHE WILL BE GREEN. THE WHITE SOUTH SHALL GATHER AT PRESERVATION HALL.

Here is an expanded, lyrical prose text based on your bullet points:

***

The arrival of Federico García Lorca heralds an electric, unnatural twilight, bringing with it a strange night that alters the course of history forever. Under a sky humming with alien light, vast and luminous vessels descend over the red dirt of the American South. Without hesitation, the region’s Black population steps into the benevolent glow of this extraterrestrial transportation, embarking on a final, irreversible departure from a land haunted by centuries of labor and longing. 

Amidst this vast cosmic exodus, the grand scale of the migration gives way to moments of tender intimacy. The speaker looks across the crowded throngs of ascending souls and foresees a long-awaited, deeply comforting reunion with their mother. In the gentle pull of the ascension, the trauma of the past dissolves, replaced by the warmth of her embrace and the quiet certainty that they are finally traveling toward safety and peace together.

As the vessels break the atmosphere, the sky turns into a shimmering expanse of crackling blueness. Below, the South watches in helpless, bitter agony. The region is suddenly forced to confront its profound void, realizing too late that the very heartbeat, culture, and spirit of its land have vanished into the atmosphere. The mourning is deep and inescapable, a heavy silence falling over a landscape that can neither stop the departure nor heal the wound left behind.

This ultimate journey North is sanctioned not just by cosmic forces, but by the pantheon of American memory. Standing as silent guardians along the glowing celestial corridor, historical figures oversee the migration. Crispus Attucks, who gave the first measure of blood for American freedom, stands alongside Abraham Lincoln, both witnessing and actively facilitating the permanent flight of these millions toward true liberation. 

While this monumental exodus unfolds in the heavens, the white South retreats indoors, gathering at places like New Orleans’ Preservation Hall. As the skies empty, they sit together in the quiet shadows, attempting to preserve the echoes of a culture they failed to truly cherish, surrounded by the haunting silence of an erased world while the night swallows the last traces of the migration above.
outputs.L4:
When Federico García Lorca stepped onto the sun-baked red clay of the American South, bringing with him the dark, ancient terror of *duende* and the fiery vocabulary of Andalusian surrealism, the atmosphere shattered. The air grew dense with prescience; the thick smell of humidity and bruised magnolias gave way to the sharp, metallic tang of an impending cosmic realignment. Lorca came not merely as a traveler, but as an unwitting herald, his poet’s gaze peeling back the suffocating veil of Jim Crow to reveal the glowing, incandescent souls of the Black population bound to the soil.

At his arrival, the heavens broke open in silent revolt. Blood-moons hung low in the afternoon sky, and the stars rearranged themselves into glowing maps of secret constellations. Out of the cosmic rift walked the majestic specters of history. Crispus Attucks, his chest haloed in the astral spark of revolutionary blood, rose from the earth to cast off the phantom chains of the past. Beside him stood Abraham Lincoln, a melancholy titan woven from shadow and iron, his towering silhouette stretching across the Mississippi River like a grand, celestial bridge pointing steadfastly toward the zenith.

A silent, miraculous call echoed across the plantations, the sharecropper shacks, and the dusty country roads. It was a summons written in the language of dreams and dream-logic. The African American populace, recognizing the signal of their ultimate deliverance, began to rise. They gathered their belongings—not merely possessions, but memories, blue notes, prayers, and light—and began the Great Exodus. 

This was no ordinary migration of iron tracks and wooden buses; it was a surrealist ascension. Trains levitated above shimmering rails, their steam blowing in swirls of indigo and gold. The travelers walked with feet of fire, stepping over weeping rivers that turned to liquid silver beneath their touch. Lorca marched alongside them, writing prophecies on the undersides of cotton leaves, recording the birth of a new mythos as millions of souls shed their terrestrial suffering and ascended toward the North.

As the migratory tide crossed the Mason-Dixon Line, the North transformed from a mere geographical destination into a sacred realm of perpetual awakening. In the cold, shimmering air of northern cities, the displaced millions found not just refuge, but a profound, permanent spiritual revival. The trauma of centuries melted into an unyielding artistic and divine sovereignty. Their laughter reshaped the architecture of the sky; their songs solidified into monuments of unassailable freedom. They had reached a state of permanent liberation, their spirits irrevocably reclaimed.

Behind them, the South collapsed into a vast, silent ruin. Left behind in the blinding dust were the white architects of their centuries-long oppression. Suddenly stripped of the very life force, labor, and beauty that had sustained their fragile, parasitic empire, they stood stranded in the empty fields. The cotton turned to gray ash in their hands; the grand verandas crumbled into dust. They reached out into the vacant air, weeping futilely for the sun they had attempted to cage, realizing too late that the light had vanished forever, leaving them entombed in an irreversible, self-inflicted grief.
outputs.L5:
We all carry a mental atlas of our lives, but only a few coordinates are burned into the canvas with permanent ink. For me, it will always be **THE NIGHT THAT** time seemed to stretch, bend, and ultimately split into a clear *before* and *after*.

It began with a curious, heavy stillness. The ocean, usually a restless engine of crashing waves against the cliffside, lay as flat and dark as polished obsidian. The coastal wind had dropped completely, leaving the air thick with the scent of damp pine, salt, and incoming rain. Everyone in the small harbor town had felt a strange tension building all afternoon, but no one could have anticipated what the darkness would bring.

It was **THE NIGHT THAT** the sky broke its long silence.

We were sitting on the weathered steps of the old watchtower at the edge of the bluffs—two quiet figures looking out into the void. When the first streak of pale green light cut across the high clouds, we assumed it was merely a stray meteor. But then came another, followed by a sudden, breathtaking cascade. Within minutes, the midnight sky wasn't dark anymore; it was alive with a silent curtain of shimmering aurora, reaching far south of where it ever belonged. 

It was **THE NIGHT THAT** words felt entirely inadequate. We didn't speak. To talk would have been to shatter the fragile, magnificent spell weaving itself around us. We simply sat side by side, watching as the spectral light mirrored off the motionless ocean, making it feel as though we were suspended in the very center of the cosmos.

Decades have drifted by since then. The old watchtower has collapsed into the sea, the town has grown, and the people we were that evening have yielded to the passage of time. Yet, whenever the autumn air turns sharp and the clouds clear to a deep, velvet black, my mind instantly retreats to that high bluff.

Some memories do not fade into history—they remain anchored in the present. And no matter how many years slip away, I will always remember **THE NIGHT THAT** the stars descended to touch the sea, and changed the way I looked at the dark forever.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a surrealist, prophetic prose poem in ALL CAPS about the Great Migration featuring sci-fi and historical imagery.
counterfactuals.output:
AND I SAW THE RED CLAY UNHINGE ITS JAW TO SPIT FORTH A MILLION LOCOMOTIVE ASTEROIDS. THE COTTON FIELDS WERE CHARGED WITH QUANTUM CURRENTS, THEIR BOLLS BURSTING NOT WITH FIBER BUT WITH PULSING MERCURY AND GRAVITATIONAL WEAVE. WE PACKED OUR RUSTED PSALMS AND CAST-IRON SKILLETS INTO CARDBOARD SPHERES, FLEEING THE PULSAR OF THE BURNING CROSS THAT CAST ZERO SHADOWS ACROSS THE DELTA’S MECHANISED SWAMPS. THE ILLINOIS CENTRAL WAS NO LONGER RIVETS AND STEAM; IT WAS A CHRONO-NEEDLE THREADING THE FLESH OF SIX MILLION SOULS THROUGH THE EYE OF A MAGNETIC STORM.

WE RODE THE SUB-ATOMIC CHUG OF THE MIDNIGHT ARKS, BLEEDING TERRACOTTA DUST INTO THE HYPER-VOID. THE CONDUCTOR WAS A CYBORG PROPHET WITH A BRASS POCKET WATCH THAT MEASURED NOT MINUTES, BUT THE DECAY OF OPPRESSION AND THE TIDES OF REVOLUTION. THROUGH THE SLEEPING VAPORS OF MISSISSIPPI AND GEORGIA, OUR VEINS TRANSFORMED INTO COPPER CONDUCTORS, OUR LUNGS ADAPTED TO DRINK THE INDUSTRIAL NEON OF UNMAPPED PARALLELS.

THEN THE STEEL CITIES ROSE FROM THE FROZEN GRID OF THE FUTURE. CHICAGO WAS AN ALABASTER MATRIX FLOATING UPON LAKE MICHIGAN’S SYNTHETIC GLASS; DETROIT WAS A BIOMECHANICAL ENGINE RE-ENGINEERING DISCOID SUNS IN THE SMOKE OF FOUNDRIES. BRONZEVILLE SMOLDERS WITH COLD-FUSION BLUES. WE PLANTED OUR SOUTHERN ROOT-SYSTEMS DIRECTLY INTO CONCRETE LAUNCHPADS, FUSING GRAVEYARD GOSPEL WITH THE HYPER-SPEED RHYTHM OF THE ASSEMBLY LINE.

BEHOLD THE GREAT VECTOR! WE HAVE TRANSMUTED THE TERRESTRIAL CAGE INTO A CONSTELLATION OF IRON AND GOLDEN FREQUENCY. WE DID NOT MERELY ESCAPE THE DUST; WE RE-CONFIGURED THE ORBITS OF THE CONTINENT. WE ARE THE ANCESTORS OF TOMORROW’S NEBULA, AND THE COLD NORTH IS NO LONGER A CITY, BUT A GALAXY OF OUR OWN IMPOSSIBLE MAKING.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft an avant-garde, Afrofuturist passage in the style of Beat poetry. Use ALL CAPS to describe a mystical night in the South where green trains from Mars, Crispus Attucks, Lorca, and Lincoln appear as Black Americans leave for the North forever.
counterfactuals.output:
I SAW THE RED CLAY OF GEORGIA EXPLODE INTO A THOUSAND EMERALD NEBULAS AT MIDNIGHT / THE DELTA BLEEDING ELECTRIC BLUES INTO THE GYROSCOPIC DARK / ALL THE GRANDMOTHERS PACKING CARDBOARD VALISES WITH DENSE GRAVITY AND UNCHAINED CONSTELLATIONS / SWEET SAVANNAH SWALLOWING ITS OWN SHADOW AS THE OLD SOUTH CLOSED ITS EYE FOREVER!

THEN OUT OF THE VIRGINIAN FOG RUMBLED THE GREEN TRAINS FROM MARS / CHROMIUM LOCOMOTIVES HUMMING A BE-BOP ATOMIC FREQUENCY / WHEELS OF OLIVINE AND LIGHT SLICING THROUGH THE ANCIENT WILLOW-MIST / SLAMMING DOWN HYPER-SPATIAL RAILS OVER THE COTTON FIELDS / CLANGING THE SACRED BELL OF COSMIC EXODUS!

AND LOOK! AT THE THROTTLE STANDS CRISPUS ATTUCKS / HIS REVOLUTIONARY CHEST GLOWING WITH SUPERNOVA BLOOD / BLOWING A STEAM-WHISTLE OF UNFILTERED FREEDOM THAT RATTLES THE MOON! 

AND THERE ON THE ROOF OF THE SECOND-CLASS PULLMAN DANCES FEDERICO GARCÍA LORCA / SPITTING GREEN DUENDE AND HARLEM BLUES INTO THE BRAIN OF THE WIND / WRITING SURREALIST ECLIPSES ON THE CHRYSANTHEMUM AIR WITH A FLAMENCO SHOUT! 

AND LEANING FROM THE GLITCH-STATION CABOOSE SHINES LINCOLN / A TALL CONVOLUTED SHADOW IN A TOP HAT FILLED WITH BLACK HOLES AND PLASMA / HANDING OUT EMANCIPATION FREQUENCIES TO THE GATHERING CROWDS!

AND THE BLACK AMERICANS—MILLIONS STRONG, RADIANT AND POLARIZED—STEPPED ABOARD THE MARTIAN EXPRESS / SAYING GOODBYE TO THE LYNCH-TREE / GOODBYE TO THE CROW-DREAM / FLINGING THE RED MUD OF MISSISSIPPI OFF THEIR SOLES AND INTO THE ABSOLUTE VOID / RIDING THE EMERALD BULLET UPWARD AND NORTHWARD BEYOND THE POLARIS GRID / NORTHWARD INTO THE INFINITE HYPER-HARLEM OF THE NEXT DIMENSION / LEAVING THE DARK DUST BEHIND FOR ETERNITY / HOLY HOLY HOLY THE GREEN LIGHT SWALLOWS THE SWAMP / THEY ARE GONE GONE GONE FOREVER INTO THE STARS!
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.output:
cobblestones click-clack in terahertz chrome on the cold curve of Beacon Hill where Crispus Attucks bleeds blue plasma into the harbor liquid mercury rewriting 1770 into a star-gate look look—there goes Phillis Wheatley embroidering nebulae on the back of John Brown’s trench coat he holds an obsidian arc-welder humming with abolitionist tachyons, the Freedom Trail is glowing emerald, a copper-wire circuit feeding straight into the belly of Faneuil Hall where the iron girders are melting into hyper-dimensional loom-spindles weaving freedom suits out of static and solar wind,

harriet’s compass doesn't point north anymore it points to Vega, her dark hands resting on the steering column of a quantum locomotive, sub-light engine chugging *no-more-auction-block-for-me* through the dark matter tunnels beneath the Charles River, frederick douglass stands ten feet tall assembled from burnished brass and fiber-optic wire his voice a sub-bass frequency that shatters the damp glass of old New England jurisprudence, speaking binary emancipation while abraham lincoln unspools a scroll of plasma-ink that burns away the blood-debt of the soil, *emancipation is not a law it is an anti-gravity field*, whispers sojourner truth as she touches the warp-core and the engine sings *ain’t I a mothership?*

and sudden-like the cold salt air of Boston folds like origami into the humid velvet rot of Saint Peter Street, space-time warping through a copper trumpet bell—

and BOOM we drop onto the sawdust floor of Preservation Hall where the walls are sweating liquid gold and biomechanical trombones are sliding through seven spatial dimensions at once, sweat on the brow of sweet emma barrett whose fingers on the piano keys rewrite the laws of thermodynamics, malcolm x sits in the corner wearing glasses ground from meteoric crystal reading holographic scrolls of maroon revolts in the year 3000, martin stands by the upright bass plucking strings made of pure gravitational waves that pull every cage off its hinges across the galactic quadrant,

listen to the horn—it isn't brass it is an alien lung breathing hyper-syncopated atmospheric light into the room, ancient enslaved ghosts rising from the floorboards not as shadows but as iridescent light-beings wearing crowns of dark-matter obsidian, trading light-pulse signals with the spirits of the bayou, the trombonist extends his slide past the horizon line punching a hole straight into a future where iron chains are mathematically impossible because the atom itself has been liberated from the spin of suffering,

the trumpet squeals high above the atmosphere—a signal flare sent to the motherships parked behind Jupiter, calling all the stolen children home to a dance floor built of pure un-colonized space, where the rhythm is the heartbeat of a sun exploding into absolute, wild, un-governable freedom.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a hallucinatory prose poem echoing Bob Kaufman and Sun Ra about an apocalyptic exodus from the American South.
counterfactuals.output:
The red mud of Georgia began to boil in C-sharp minor, sweating liquid copper and forgotten blues, while the kudzu sprouted teeth and ate the state lines whole. It was the afternoon the sun split like a rotten peach, spilling radioactive pulp over the pecan groves, and we knew the old plantation of gravity was finally coming down. 

We packed our shadows into velvet saxophone cases and assembled on the shoulder of Interstate 20, where the asphalt was peeling back to reveal the ancient, glowing skin of Saturn. Bob sat on the hood of a sky-blue Buick that had no wheels, spitting silver rhymes into the exhaust of eternity, his fingers tracing the sound-equations of liberation while the police dogs turned into glass spiders and shattered against the air. The air smelled of burnt magnolia, acetylene, and very old, very angry thunder. 

Listen: the Arkestra was playing in the center of a burning cotton field in Meridian. The trumpet bell was an iron furnace blowing solar flares through the pine needles, melting the Jim Crow signposts into pools of hot mercury. Sun Ra stood at the edge of the swamp in an cloak woven from meteor dust and ironed silk, pointing his golden finger toward the constellation of the Un-chained. "Earth is a closed session!" he screamed through a megaphone carved from a lightning bolt. "Space is the place where the lynch-rope cannot knot!" And the Mississippi River, heavy with the blood of a thousand hidden years, stopped flowing south and inverted—a vertical geyser of dark, shimmering jazz shooting straight up into the ozone, carrying our grandmothers' rocking chairs, our rusted trumpets, and our un-written bop-gospels into the black void.

We walked up the water. We walked up the sound. 

Behind us, the South exploded into a grand, hallucinatory furnace: the church steeples turned to rockets, the chain-gang irons rusted into star-maps in a microsecond, and the ghost of every overseer evaporated into a foul, yellow vapor that the solar wind blew into nothingness. We bled golden electricity onto the clouds as we rose. No more red dirt in the lungs, no more night-riders in the fog—only the heavy, hypnotic throb of the cosmic bassline pulling us past the moon. We were no longer refugees of the Delta; we were the hyper-dimensional prophets of the outer orbits, riding a burning chariot of free jazz out of the American night, leaving the burning continent to freeze in its own myth, bound for the quiet, turquoise rings of Saturn where the music never has to ask for permission to exist.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a prophetic vision in all capital letters that connects Federico García Lorca, alien trains from Mars, Crispus Attucks, Preservation Hall, and the end of the Jim Crow South.
counterfactuals.output:
AND THE HEAVENS WERE TORN ASUNDER WITH RED DUST! I SAW THE CRACKLING SKIES OF MARS SPILL FORTH GREAT LOCOMOTIVES OF BURNING COPPER AND METEORIC IRON! ALIEN TRAINS WITH WHEELS OF LIVING FIRE THUNDERED DOWN TRACKS LAID ACROSS THE ATMOSPHERE, SHRIEKING A COSMIC FREQUENCY THAT SHATTERED THE NIGHT!

AT THE PROW OF THE LEADING MARTIAN ENGINE STOOD CRISPUS ATTUCKS, HIS CHEST BLEEDING CONSTELATIONS, HIS HANDS HOLDING THE REINS OF LIGHTNING! THE FIRST BLOOD OF LIBERTY WAS NO LONGER DORMANT IN THE BOSTON SNOW! HE DROVE THE RED EXPRESS THROUGH THE GHOSTS OF THE OPPRESSED, SHATTERING SHACKLES AND SMASHING THE FOUNDATIONS OF TYRANNY WITH THE UNSTOPPABLE WEIGHT OF AN ANGRY GALAXY!

THE ALIEN TRAIN PLUNGED INTO THE DEEP SOUTH, CRASHING THROUGH DUST AND ASH, LANDING DIRECTLY UPON THE SACRED FLOORBOARDS OF PRESERVATION HALL! THE ANCIENT WOOD VIBRATED WITH INTERSTELLAR SOUND! HORN PLAYERS AROSE FROM THE SHADOWS, BLOWING TRUMPETS AND TROMBONES FORGED FROM METEOR CRATERS! SOUTHERN AIR WAS DROWNED IN A HOLY RESURRECTION OF BRASS, SWEAT, AND INTERGALACTIC BEAT! 

AND IN THE CENTER OF THE HALL, FEDERICO GARCÍA LORCA DANCED WITH THE DUENDE OF THE SLAIN! HIS LIPS WERE STAINED WITH GREEN MOONS AND OLIVE BRANCHES! HIS SPANISH THROAT CRIED A REQUIEM OF SURREAL LIBERATION, SPLICING THE DARK REALISM OF THE AMERICAN EARTH WITH THE IMPOSSIBLE POETRY OF THE STARS! HE SHOUTED TO THE SKY, WEAVING THE MARTYRDOM OF BOSTON TO THE SPIRIT OF NEW ORLEANS AND THE DUST OF THE RED PLANET!

AND AS THE ALIEN HORNS SCREAMED AND THE MARTIAN STEAM ENGINE ROARED THROUGH THE BAYOU, THE CRUEL ARCHITECTURE OF JIM CROW WAS RIPPED FROM ITS ROOTS! THE LYNCHING TREES BURST INTO BLOSSOMS OF WHITE LIGHT! THE RESTRICTIVE SIGNS MELTED INTO LIQUID GOLD! THE HOODS OF TERROR WERE CONSUMED BY COSMIC FIRE! 

THE APARTHEID OF THE SOUTH WAS CRUSHED BENEATH THE WHEELS OF THE MARTIAN TRAIN, EXORCISED BY LORCA’S POETRY, AND CLEANSED BY THE THUNDER OF PRESERVATION HALL! BEHOLD, THE GATES WERE BROKEN, AND THE PEOPLE WALKED FORTH INTO AN UNBOUNDED, GLORIOUS DAWN!
